suffix: The cat is the exact same jet-black short-haired cat as the reference: glossy black fur, molten-gold amber eyes with slit pupils, small notch in the left ear tip, tiny white chest tuft. Cinematic film still, real photograph, 85mm, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed fur, chiaroscuro, deep crimson and black palette, subtle film grain. No humans, no text, not cartoon, not illustration, not 3D render.

shots.01_eyes_dark: Total darkness. Only the two glowing molten-gold eyes of a jet-black cat emerge from pure black shadow, a faint crimson rim light touching the whiskers and the edges of the ears, thin red fog. Frontal, centered, close-up of the face, the rest of the frame pitch black.
shots.02_eye_macro: Extreme macro photograph of a single cat eye filling the whole frame: molten-gold amber iris with intricate fibers, razor-thin vertical black slit pupil, a glossy wet cornea reflecting a red lightning bolt, rim of jet-black fur around the eye.
shots.03_rooftop_moon: Silhouette of a jet-black cat sitting on the edge of a rooftop at night in heavy rain, seen from a very low angle, a gigantic blood-red full moon right behind it, dark city skyline far below, rain streaks lit red. Epic wide vertical composition.
shots.04_walk_smoke: A jet-black cat walking straight toward the camera on wet black asphalt at night, ground-level low angle, one front paw lifted mid-step, thick smoke behind it backlit in crimson, red reflections in puddles, determined gaze straight into the lens.
shots.05_profile_wind: Side profile close-up of a jet-black cat's head facing right, strong wind blowing its fur and long whiskers backward, golden eye glowing, hard crimson rim light, glowing embers and sparks flying past, black background.
shots.06_meow_front: Close-up of a jet-black cat facing the camera with its mouth wide open in a fierce meow, sharp white fangs and pink tongue visible, golden eyes, crackling red electric sparks around its head, fur blown back by a shockwave, black background, crimson rim light.
shots.07_meow_side: Three-quarter close-up of a jet-black cat yowling a loud meow with its head tilted up toward the sky, mouth wide open, golden eyes narrowed, red lightning crackling in a dark sky behind, raindrops frozen mid-air.
shots.08_throne: A jet-black cat sitting upright like an emperor on top of a tall cracked black marble pedestal in a vast dark temple hall, worm's-eye view from the floor, a single crimson light beam falling from above, dust particles and red smoke, symmetrical composition, the cat looks down at the viewer.
shots.09_lightning: Extreme low-angle worm's-eye view of a jet-black cat standing on a jagged black rock, staring down into the camera, behind it a dark storm sky split by several violent red-white lightning bolts, wind blowing its fur.
shots.10_stare: Tight frontal symmetrical close-up of a jet-black cat's face staring directly into the lens with unblinking intensity, golden eyes wide, heat distortion shimmering in the air, harsh red light from below, black background.
shots.11_cosmic_rock: A jet-black cat sitting calmly on a small floating asteroid rock in deep outer space, a huge crimson and violet nebula behind it, countless stars, a ringed planet in the distance, the cat's golden eyes glowing.
shots.12_cosmic_aura: Close-up of a jet-black cat surrounded by a blazing aura of crimson and violet cosmic energy and swirling galaxy dust, its golden eyes emitting thin beams of light, stars reflecting in its fur, deep space background.
shots.13_cosmic_god: A colossal jet-black cat looming above the curved horizon of a planet seen from orbit, like a god, golden eyes glowing, a crimson nebula and spiral galaxies behind, a bright sun flare on the planet's horizon, epic cosmic scale.
shots.14_eyes_closed: Close-up of a jet-black cat with its eyes calmly closed, as if meditating before battle, faint crimson light, floating dust particles, slow red smoke, black background.
